claims.author: fjahr
claims.harm: the GitHub pulls endpoint lacks a draft query parameter, causing the draft PR filter to be ignored
claims.quote: There is no `draft` parameter on this endpoint so this filter is ignored: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pulls/pulls?apiVersion=2026-03-10 Would probably need a manual filter function.

claims.author: fjahr
claims.harm: fetching head again during the test run can cause the older recorded head_sha to be reported for newer commits if a force push occurs
claims.quote: If there was a force push in between, then the old `head_sha` is reported but the result is actually for the newer head. I think the older `head_sha` doesn't actually need to be recorded.
